name: Formats list grid
purpose: Show the range of formats or deliverables on offer as a scannable two-column list beside a heading and short explanation.
description: A legacy green hairline component (`.section_learn`, no right border) on a 0.75fr / 1fr grid: left = serif 4rem/1.1 H2 + 16px paragraph; right = 2-column list of items, each a green-outlined icon box (plus glyph) + 20px/500 white label, hairline left/bottom rules (last row unruled). Stacks to one column <=767 (list keeps 2 columns). No variants; theme is fixed green.
